meta.title: Velopass Pro — Every bike. A customer for life.
meta.description: With Velopass, every customer who buys a bike stays automatically connected to your shop. POS integration or free Pro app for bike shops in BE, NL and FR.
meta.ogDescription: For bike shops: keep lifelong contact with your customers via the international bike register.

hero.sub: As long as the bike rides, your shop remains their first point of contact.

pillars.title: Four reasons why {{count}} bike shops trust Velopass

p1.title: Customers who come back
p1.body: Automatic maintenance reminders bring your customers back to your shop — without you having to do anything.

p2.title: Extra services, zero extra work
p2.body: Offer insurance and roadside assistance via Velopass — automatically, at the right moment. Every activation earns you Credits.
p2.tag: Our goal: Velopass ultimately costs you nothing

p3.title: One scan, full picture
p3.body: Scan the QR on any bike — even bikes you've never sold. You immediately see the maintenance history, active services and contract info like a remaining lease budget. An unknown bike? Automatically created in your POS system.
p3.reported: Scan a REPORTED bike? Via Velopass you can notify the owner and/or police.

p4.title: Free tool for your team
p4.body: The Velopass Pro App is free for every technician in your shop. Scan, register and manage bikes on the shop floor — without extra software, without a subscription. Works alongside your POS system or fully standalone.

how.title: From sale to active customer relationship — <green>in one scan.</green>

step1.title: Scan or register the bike
step1.posBody: Bike and customer data — including email address — are already present. Scan the Frame-ID and invoice the bike. Everything happens automatically.
step1.appBody: Enter customer data manually, including the email address. Bike data is loaded automatically if the manufacturer has pre-filled it — if not, enter it manually too.

step2.title: The customer receives an invitation from your shop
step2.body: Velopass automatically sends an email on behalf of your shop — with your shop name. The customer sees: 'Your Velopass is ready.' They just choose a password — done in 1 minute.

step3.title: Automatic contact
step3.body: Velopass sends maintenance reminders in your name. You decide which reminders are sent, when — or none at all. The customer stays connected to your shop without you having to do anything more.

register.title: Register your bike shop
register.sub: Register for free and receive 5 introductory stickers. No contract, no obligations. You set the pace.
register.packageItem2: Access to the Velopass partner portal
register.packageItem3: Integration with your POS system — bike data goes in and out automatically
register.packageItem4: Free access to the Velopass Pro App — for those who scan on the go or don't have a POS system yet
register.packageItem5: Onboarding in your language: NL · FR · EN
register.packageNote: After registration we will contact you within 2 working days and send your package.
register.feat1Body: Works with your existing POS system. Or use the free Pro app.
register.feat2Body: Every activation brings you closer to free usage.
register.feat3Body: We help you get started. In your language.

community.title: Join a growing network
community.sub: {{count}}+ bike shops are already connected. The network grows every day — and every new shop makes the system stronger for everyone.
community.note: Cyclists all across Europe can already order a Velopass.

contactCta.title: Still have questions?
contactCta.sub: Our team is happy to help.

fab.title: Top manufacturers choose Velopass
fab.sub: More and more manufacturers deliver their bikes with a Velopass Frame-ID already on the frame. Scan on arrival — bike data is already ready in your POS system. No sticker to apply, no data to enter.
fab.feat1Body: The Frame-ID is built in as a decal during production — under the varnish, just like the brand name and striping. Permanent and irremovable.
fab.feat2Body: Brand, model and specifications are already in Velopass. The shop and cyclist don't need to enter anything manually.
fab.feat3Body: The Velopass code is also on the box — easy to register on delivery, before the bike even hits the floor.

makers.oxfordSub: Frame-ID built in as decal — permanent and irremovable. Data pre-filled, code on the box.
makers.oxfordExtra: Oxford also offers Oxford Assistance (by VAB) and warranty registration via Velopass — automatically linked to every sold bike.
makers.granvilleSub: Frame-ID integrated under the paint, with pre-filled bike data.
makers.granvilleExtra: Granville automatically activates the warranty via Velopass — linked to every new bike.
makers.veloeSub: Frame-ID on the paint with pre-filled bike data.
makers.defaultSub: Frame-ID applied to the frame — no bike data pre-filled.

fab.flowZone1Body: The bike is delivered with a Velopass Frame-ID. Bike data is already ready in Velopass.
fab.flowZone2Body: Scan the code on the box or on the bike after unpacking. Bike data is automatically ready in your POS system. That's all.
fab.flowStep1Body: Velopass automatically sends an email in your name upon invoicing.
fab.flowStep2Body: The customer chooses a password. Their Velopass is already ready.
fab.flowClosingDim: No sticker to apply. No data to enter.
fab.flowClosingGreen: Scan on arrival — and the rest happens automatically.
fab.ctaTitle: Make life easier for your dealer
fab.ctaBody: Manufacturers who integrate Velopass give their dealers a flying start. The bike is ready to use before it reaches the shop floor. Want to know what Velopass can mean for your brand and dealer network?

leasing.title: One sticker. All leasing companies.
leasing.sub: Every leasing company had its own sticker with a unique number. Smart in its simplicity — but for the dealer it meant stock per company and no digital info. Velopass harmonised that.
leasing.logosDesc: They have integrated Velopass — less admin for you, more service for your customers.
leasing.problemsTitle: Before: one sticker per leasing company
leasing.problem2: Risk of wrong sticker on wrong bike
leasing.problem3: Time lost for every lease bike
leasing.solutionsTitle: Now: one Frame-ID for all customer types
leasing.solution1: One sticker for leasing, private and company bikes
leasing.solution2: Paid by the leasing company — with margin for the dealer
leasing.scanSub: Scan the Frame-ID on arrival and immediately see all info about the lease bike — without calling, without searching.
leasing.scanItem1Body: Name and logo of the company
leasing.scanItem3Title: Contract number and lease end date
leasing.scanItem4Title: Direct link to this bike in the leasing company portal
leasing.appAlt: Velopass Pro app on smartphone with lease data next to a blue e-bike
leasing.howTitle: Link a lease bike in 2 steps
leasing.howContext: The bike data is already in your POS system — via a previous scan or manual entry.
leasing.step1Body: Does the bike not yet have a Velopass Frame-ID? Apply one to the frame. It takes 10 seconds.
leasing.step1Note: Many manufacturers deliver the bike with one already — then skip this step.
leasing.step2Title: Enter the code in the lease portal
leasing.step2Body: Enter the Velopass code of the bike in the leasing company portal. Done — the bike, owner and portal are linked.
leasing.resultBannerPre: Scan the bike afterwards with the Pro App or POS system? Then you immediately see everything:
leasing.resultBannerHighlight: company, budget, contract number, end date, and more...
leasing.ctaNote: Not a partner yet? Register for free and receive 5 Frame-ID stickers to try.
